k1024.exempt_reason: cache-resident frame; the DRAM roofline does not bound it

k4096.exempt_reason: cache-resident frame; the DRAM roofline does not bound it

gates.bandwidth_note: the gate is applied per frame; a cache-resident frame is exempt by name, not pooled away

null_scaffold.note: a scaffold move in a resident frame is a RESULT, not a session fault: every price here is a rung contrast that cancels the scaffold, and the scaffold arm is bit identical to a_base in every frame

exclusions.rule: a (arm, width) key that failed one exact check is dropped at that width in every frame; a class is priced only where both of its rungs survive
exclusions.note: the raw session_valid above is left false on purpose. This field states which cells remain sound, it does not overturn the gate
